about.title: About
paragraphs: With a year of experience at UWEZO, I've built solid, hands-on skills in designing modern web applications. That real-world experience sharpened my approach, combining backend rigor, responsive interfaces, and product sense.

I mainly code server-side with Laravel, Spring Boot, and Nest.js, and front-end with Angular and Next.js. I also have a strong DevOps mindset: Linux day-to-day, Docker, continuous integration, and cloud deployment.
